description_lines: Hilton Toronto Airport Hotel & Office/Warehouse Bldg
The Hilton Toronto Airport Hotel comprises two high-rise towers (north and south buildings) with guest suites, interconnected by a two-storey building section.
The total gross floor area is approximately 305,000 ft².
The south building has 11-storeys with 262 guest rooms and was constructed in 1971. Major renovations were conducted in 1998.
The north building has 9-storeys with 151 guest rooms, and was constructed in about 1986. The building is mostly original, apart from interior finishes.

A two-storey section connects the south and north towers. The main level has banquet facilities, kitchens, a restaurant, office and small retail facilities. The lower level has offices, staff lounges and facilities, an abandoned nightclub, and service rooms.

There is also an office/warehouse building located to the north-west of the hotel facility. There is a 2-storey office on the south side of the building (occupied by Hilton) and a rental car tenant (Advantage) occupies a single-storey office section at the southwest corner. The remainder is warehouse used for indoor parking by Hilton and a section is used by Advantage for vehicle cleaning. The gross floor area is approximately 53,000 ft².
